fee_notes: The initial franchise fee is $30,000, payable in a lump sum and non-refundable, uniformly imposed on all franchisees. A 50% discount ($15,000) is available to qualified veterans under the IFA VetFran Program. An additional New Restaurant Marketing Program Fee of $10,000 is charged when the premises lease is signed. A training fee of $8,000 may be charged for the second and subsequent restaurants under certain conditions. A Development Fee of $15,000 per restaurant ($30,000–$75,000 total for 2–5 units) applies if a Development Agreement is signed.
raw_excerpt: When you sign a Franchise Agreement, you will pay us an initial franchise fee of $30,000. This fee is payable in a lump sum and is not refundable. This fee is uniformly imposed on all franchisees.
